cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You saw the finish. Say I won that race fairly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can mention them slowing. Just don't say they handed me the race.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One of them stopped to tie a shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them I checked my knots. I'll settle for winning on preparation.

reason: A negotiates the witness account by allowing the slowing fact and shifting the requested deserved credit after B shoe explanation.
